prior_information: Seven timeline native component scores and the fitting-only arrival audit were observed. The complete timeline selection and all arrival model scores were still unavailable. Equal learner means were chosen without inspecting their complete results.
routing: Use the unchanged clock-availability covariate. Clock-present rows use the predeclared equal mean of timeline LGB/CatBoost globals with 50% original v6 airports; missing-clock rows use the equal mean of the two new arrival-context experts. Apply each common blend weight against v6.
selection: Require both preceding batches and their native verifications complete. Evaluate exactly two recipes on each original complete fold; require at least 0.5% lower complete RMSE on both folds, then choose the minimum equal-weight mean relative RMSE. No other weights or per-airport rules.
